topic: Write a Summary of a General-Specific Speech(为一篇“总—分”演讲写摘要)
title_en: A Summary of "How to Keep Your Audience Engaged"
genre: 摘要写作 / summary(grasp the general statement + main details of a general-specific text)
source: 上外版选择性必修四 Unit 1 Writing:Writing a summary of a general-specific essay。围绕“如何让听众保持专注”的演讲,抓住总述句和几条要点,用自己的话写一篇不超过60词的摘要。
prompt_cn: 一位演讲者在你校做了题为《如何在演讲时让听众保持专注》的报告。你的朋友很感兴趣却未能到场,请你用英语写一篇不超过60词的摘要分享给他/她。要求:① 用一句话概括演讲的总观点;② 用自己的话提炼出三到四条具体建议;③ 不照抄原文长句,代词指代清楚、句句围绕中心。
prompt_en: A speaker gave a talk at your school called "How to Keep Your Audience Engaged While Delivering a Speech." A friend was interested but could not attend. Write a summary in no more than 60 words including: 1) one sentence stating the speaker's general point; 2) three or four key pieces of advice in your own words; 3) no long copying from the original, with clear pronoun reference.
points: 总述句概括(The speaker explained how to keep listeners engaged …)
提炼要点1-2(speak with passion; move on stage)
提炼要点3-4(show some personality; offer real value, not a sales pitch)
用自己的话改写、不超60词、句句围绕中心
model_essay: In her talk, the speaker explained how to keep an audience engaged during a speech. She advised speakers to talk with real passion, to move around the stage to add energy, and to let a little personality show through stories or humour. Above all, she said, offer the listeners something truly valuable instead of sounding like a salesperson.
model_translation: 在演讲中,这位讲者讲解了如何在演讲时让听众保持专注。她建议演讲者要满怀激情地讲、在台上走动以增添活力,并通过故事或幽默展现一点个性。她说,最重要的是为听众提供真正有价值的东西,而不要听起来像在推销。

rubric.criteria: 总观点 + 三到四条要点齐全、准确反映原文
先总后分、句句围绕中心、代词指代清楚、不超60词
用自己的话转述、不照抄长句、句型词汇准确多样

required_structure: 总述 The speaker explained how to …
要点1-2 She advised speakers to … and to …
要点4 Above all, … instead of …
key_expressions: The speaker explained how to keep an audience engaged.
She advised speakers to talk with real passion.
Move around the stage to add energy.
Offer the listeners something truly valuable instead of sounding like a salesperson.

high_sentences: The speaker explained how to keep an audience engaged during a speech.
She advised speakers to talk with real passion and to move around the stage.
Letting a little personality show makes listeners warm to you.
Offer the audience something truly valuable instead of sounding like a salesperson.

error_pairs.wrong: The speaker explained how to keep engaged the audience.
error_pairs.correct: The speaker explained how to keep the audience engaged.
error_pairs.note: keep + 宾语 + 形容词,宾语放在 keep 之后。

error_pairs.wrong: She advised speakers talk with passion.
error_pairs.correct: She advised speakers to talk with passion.
error_pairs.note: advise sb to do sth,不定式带 to。

error_pairs.wrong: Offer something valuable instead of to sound like a salesperson.
error_pairs.correct: Offer something valuable instead of sounding like a salesperson.

paragraph_template:
【总—分演讲摘要结构】
第1句 总述:The speaker explained how to …
第2-3句 要点:She advised speakers to … ; she also suggested …
第4句 升华:Above all, … instead of …
(全文≤60词,用自己的话,勿照抄长句)
